problem: Which of the following describes the $c$-level surfaces of the function $f(x,y,z)=\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-{z}^{2}},$ where $c>0?$

choices.value: A family of hyperboloids of one sheet: $cx-2cy+3cz-8=0$
A family of hyperboloids of one sheet: $\frac{{x}^{2}}{{c}^{2}}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{{c}^{2}}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{{c}^{2}}=1$

feedback.problem: Which of the following describes the level surfaces of the function $f(x,y,z)=-{x}^{2}-3{y}^{2}+z+3?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The level surfaces of the function $f(x,y,z)$ are given by the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y,z) & =c \\ -{x}^{2}-3{y}^{2}+z+3 & =c \\ z & ={x}^{2}+3{y}^{2}+c-3\end{aligned}
$$

If we let $c-3=C,$ we get a family of elliptic paraboloids:

$$
z={x}^{2}+3{y}^{2}+C,\,C\in (-\infty ,\infty )
$$
